headline: Saudi Energy Ministry: hostile aerial projectile struck Aramco's Jazan refinery, killing one worker, injuring several; fire controlled, some operations temporarily halted pending damage assessment.
already_priced_evidence: Post-close (CNBC/Reuters 2026-11-27): Jan Brent settled $95.44 (-1.2%) and Jan WTI $83.08 (~-1% vs Wed; no Thu WTI settle) after early gains; Brent +3% on week (first weekly gain in Nov), WTI -0.4% on week. veto_reason: Verified strike but halt is partial/temporary at one refinery with no confirmed export-capacity loss; not classed as a major supply shock. Reassess after damage assessment.
